`Intent Drift Check` 固定至少檢查三件事：
`README.md`、`quickstart.md`、analyze 結論沒有把 representative subset 偽裝成原始完整能力。
Create or update `intent-ledger.md` when core spec items are `represented_by_substitute`, `deferred`, or `dropped_with_owner_signoff`.
If any proposed drop lacks explicit owner signoff reference, route to `ROUTE_TO_DECISION` instead of normalizing the drop.
`eci-trigger.md` is the mandatory intake seed for `/speckit.eci`.

If `Authorization Outcome = READY_FOR_SANDBOX_ONLY` or `READY_FOR_SPIKE_ONLY`, choose the next blocker required to upgrade authorization (usually validation, access, or a real owner decision) instead of repeating `ROUTE_TO_ECI`.
Use `ROUTE_TO_ECI` again only when the dossier is missing, stale, misrouted, contradictory, or no longer matches current scope.
Always recommend `/speckit.readiness` as the next command.
If `READINESS_ASSESSMENT` does not exist: ERROR and instruct the user to run `/speckit.readiness`
If `Primary Status` is anything other than `READY_FOR_PLAN`: ERROR
If it is anything other than `READY_FOR_MAINLINE_IMPLEMENTATION`: ERROR
ERROR if `authorization-record.md` exists but does not authorize `READY_FOR_MAINLINE_IMPLEMENTATION`

Fill `Intent Recovery Obligations` from `intent-ledger.md` when required
Ensure the plan names any required README / quickstart coverage disclosure when umbrella naming is broader than the current representative subset
Require concrete re-entry triggers; do **not** accept generic placeholders such as `v1+`

Identify inconsistencies, duplications, ambiguities, underspecified items, readiness-gate violations, intent drift, and document drift across the core execution artifacts (`spec.md`, `intent-ledger.md`, `readiness/*.md`, `readiness/eci/*.md`, `plan.md`, `tasks.md`)
